" Don't Tap Red is simple to play!\n Players tap on the green tiles while avoiding the red tiles as the board refreshes with new tiles at a faster pace.\n The goal is to keep tapping green tiles and continue playing for as long as possible.\n The game ends when a player taps a red tile and gets out."
